Return only JSON with refs and code. refs is exactly all top-level FACTS keys, no duplicates or nested keys.
code defines solve(facts) returning the answer and check(answer,facts) returning bool using an independent derivation.
Read inputs from facts; do not hardcode the supplied dataset. Do not call solve from check or return constant success.
Allowed imports: math fractions itertools functools collections heapq bisect decimal operator statistics.
Allowed builtins: abs all any bool chr dict divmod enumerate filter float frozenset int isinstance iter len list map max min next ord pow range reversed round set slice sorted str sum tuple zip hash Exception ValueError KeyError IndexError ZeroDivisionError StopIteration.
No IO, class, private attributes, eval, exec, open, bin, type or introspection. Total solve/check must finish within 4 seconds.
TASK:
One machine at time 0, all jobs exactly once, nonpreemptive. Each job starts as early as possible after release, previous job completion and all predecessors; no discretionary idle. Reject orders with later predecessors. Minimize weighted tardiness sum(weight*max(0,completion-due)); ties minimize final completion, then lexicographic id sequence. Return exactly order, starts aligned to order, finish, weighted_tardiness.
FACTS:
{"jobs":[{"id":"K0","duration":5,"release":4,"due":29,"weight":2,"predecessors":[]},{"id":"K1","duration":7,"release":3,"due":22,"weight":6,"predecessors":["K0"]},{"id":"K2","duration":2,"release":6,"due":17,"weight":3,"predecessors":["K1"]},{"id":"K3","duration":4,"release":2,"due":30,"weight":2,"predecessors":[]}]}

{"refs":["jobs"],"code":"def solve(facts):
    jobs=facts['jobs']; n=len(jobs); ids=[j['id'] for j in jobs]; ix={v:i for i,v in enumerate(ids)}
    pred=[sum(1<<ix[x] for x in j['predecessors']) for j in jobs]
    best=None
    def rec(mask,t,order,starts,cost):
        nonlocal best
        if mask==(1<<n)-1:
            key=(cost,t,tuple(ids[i] for i in order))
            if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,order[:],starts[:])
            return
        for i,j in enumerate(jobs):
            bit=1<<i
            if mask&bit or pred[i]&mask!=pred[i]: continue
            s=max(t,j['release']); c=s+j['duration']; nc=cost+j['weight']*max(0,c-j['due'])
            if best is not None and nc>best[0][0]: continue
            rec(mask|bit,c,order+[i],starts+[s],nc)
    rec(0,0,[],[],0)
    key,order,starts=best
    return {'order':[ids[i] for i in order],'starts':starts,'finish':key[1],'weighted_tardiness':key[0]}
def check(answer,facts):
    jobs=facts['jobs']; n=len(jobs); ids=[j['id'] for j in jobs]; ix={v:i for i,v in enumerate(ids)}
    if not isinstance(answer,dict) or set(answer.keys())!={'order','starts','finish','weighted_tardiness'}: return False
    order=answer['order']; starts=answer['starts']
    if len(order)!=n or len(starts)!=n or set(order)!=set(ids): return False
    t=0; mask=set(); cost=0
    for k,name in enumerate(order):
        if name not in ix: return False
        j=jobs[ix[name]]
        if any(p not in mask for p in j['predecessors']): return False
        s=max(t,j['release'])
        if starts[k]!=s: return False
        t=s+j['duration']; cost+=j['weight']*max(0,t-j['due']); mask.add(name)
    if answer['finish']!=t or answer['weighted_tardiness']!=cost: return False
    # Independently enumerate every feasible sequence to certify all tie-breaks.
    optimum=None
    def visit(done,tm,seq,cc):
        nonlocal optimum
        if len(seq)==n:
            key=(cc,tm,tuple(seq))
            if optimum is None or key<optimum: optimum=key
            return
        for j in jobs:
            name=j['id']
            if name in done or any(p not in done for p in j['predecessors']): continue
            end=max(tm,j['release'])+j['duration']
            visit(done|{name},end,seq+[name],cc+j['weight']*max(0,end-j['due']))
    visit(set(),0,[],0)
    return (cost,t,tuple(order))==optimum"}
